chapter.title: Configuration
chapter.para: JetOS has no run-time configuration: a module is described once, in a configuration file in the XML format of ARINC 653 part 1, and the kernel is built for that description.

section.title: SRQ_JET_CFG_001
section.para: JetOS shall take the configuration of the module, that is its partitions, their memory, the schedule, the ports and the channels between them, and the health monitoring tables, from a description that is fixed when it is built, and shall not change it while it runs.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A fixed configuration is what makes the behaviour of the module predictable and certifiable.

section.title: SRQ_JET_CFG_002
section.para: The schedule of a module shall be an ordered list of slots; the duration of a slot shall be at least 1 millisecond; the length of a major frame shall be the sum of the durations of its slots; the kind of a slot shall be partition, spare, monitor, GDB or networking.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The slots are what the time partitioning is made of.

section.title: SRQ_JET_CFG_003
section.para: JetOS shall be built only from a configuration in which: the first slot belongs to a partition; every partition has at least one slot in which its periodic processing may start; a slot for networking is present if and only if networking is configured; the memory blocks mapped into one partition do not share pages; names that identify partitions, ports and memory blocks are unique when compared without regard to case; and the sizes of the messages of the two ends of a channel agree.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: An inconsistent configuration is found when the module is built, not when it flies.

section.title: SRQ_JET_CFG_004
section.para: JetOS shall treat names of partitions, processes, ports and memory blocks as equal when they differ only in case.

section.title: SRQ_JET_CFG_005
section.para: The configuration shall give each partition: a name, an identifier, a period (the major frame if none is given), the size of its memory, its ports, and its health monitoring table; and shall tell whether it is a kernel-only partition.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These are the properties of a partition that the kernel needs to schedule it and to give it memory.

section.title: SRQ_JET_CFG_006
section.para: The configuration shall give the module a health monitoring table, and each partition one, mapping a system state and an error to an action; where an entry is missing the action shall be shutting down the module for the module table and idling the partition for a partition table.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The default is the safe side of each level.
